description: The facts an agent needs before installing or deploying one project: Docker files, arm64 build, GPU need, minimum RAM, outside services it needs, web port, what its README says it needs, docs and demo links, and upkeep (latest release, releases in 12 months, security advisories, its package). null means Archestack does not know. Archestack does not track hosting cost or deploy templates.

project.description: Project id like "best-of-ai/qdrant", a GitHub repo like "qdrant/qdrant", or a name like "Qdrant"

name: deploy_facts
title: What it takes to run a project
